technical.summary: Bullish structure with price above key moving averages and positive momentum, but overbought RSI conditions and negative CMF limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: RL shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 90 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (680+ days old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (395.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; 90-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with bullish EMA 9/21 crossover and positive OBV in extreme fear environment (22/100) offers contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Dual RSI overbought conditions, negative CMF, crisis-level VIX (395.2), zero fundamental conviction, no active strategy triggers, and unfavourable macro environment create excessive risk for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows bullish price positioning above 200-EMA with positive OBV, but overbought RSI conditions and negative CMF severely limit entry quality in a crisis VIX environment.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (395.2) combined with dual RSI overbought, zero fundamental conviction, and 90-day earnings event risk create excessive downside exposure for swing trade.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Existing RL position plus 16 open Consumer Discretionary positions create sector concentration; skip entry to avoid compounding exposure in unfavourable macro regime.
